tns:patch.author: AMP
tns:patch.description: Recreate the third indicator disaggregation dimension view.

script.lang: SELECT settingsvalue FROM amp_global_settings where settingsname='Recreate the views on the next server restart';

DROP VIEW IF EXISTS v_indicator_disaggregation_level_2; CREATE VIEW v_indicator_disaggregation_level_2 AS SELECT DISTINCT con.activity_id AS amp_activity_id, category.category_value AS name, category.id AS category_value_id, ind.indicator_id AS me_indicator_id, theme.amp_theme_id AS me_npo_id FROM amp_indicator_connection con JOIN amp_indicator ind ON ind.indicator_id = con.indicator_id JOIN amp_indicator_disaggregation_values value ON ind.indicator_id = value.indicator_id JOIN amp_indicator_global_value base ON value.base_value_id = base.id JOIN amp_category_value category ON category.id = value.third_category_id LEFT JOIN amp_theme theme ON ind.program_id = theme.amp_theme_id WHERE con.activity_id IS NOT NULL AND base.type = 2 ORDER BY con.activity_id;
